This is a SOURCES SOUGHT RFI Only.

HPE DL380/DL380a servers, storage and switches, described in the SOW (attached), to support a range of patterns and

This effort will ensure FIPS 140-3 compliance is met and appropriate levels of
technology infrastructure for enterprise analytics and mitigate risks to other management and technical controls related to the
separation of production, development, test, and prototyping environments.

Details of specific servers required and warranty are
listed in the SOW.
